device.category: 20-voice dual-layer polyphonic binaural analogue-hybrid synthesizer, 61 keys with polyphonic aftertouch, ribbon controller
device.based_on: Two-layer expansion of the UDO Super 6 engine (UK, 2023); panel design with Axel Hartmann.

sources.title: UDO Super Gemini Owner's Manual, version 1.0 (November 2023)
sources.note: Complete: performances and patches, connections, both layers' sound design, effects, performance controls, ribbon, keyboard modes, matrix, voice assign, arp/seq, globals, CC/RPN/NRPN tables.

architecture.polyphony_mode: 20 voices; binaural pairs them into 10 stereo super voices (single) or 5 per layer (dual/split); non-binaural gives 20 (single) or 10 per layer; per layer POLY 1, POLY 2, SOLO, LEGATO, unison
architecture.patch_memory_note: 128 performances (2 groups x 8 banks x 8) each holding both layers' patches and performance settings; 256 patches (2 groups x 16 banks A1-H2 x 8); 32 alternative waves; 16 sequences; USB drive 'GEMINI'.
architecture.summary: Two layers, upper and lower, each a complete binaural Super 6-style engine with its own row of controls: DDS 1 (seven-oscillator super core, classic or alternative waves, morphing), DDS 2 (norm, ring or sync; LFO range with square or sine sub), MIX and pan, a 6 dB analogue high-pass into an SSI 4-pole 24 dB low-pass with drive, a VCA with fixed-envelope options, ENV 1 (hold stages, invert, loop) and ENV 2, LFO 1 (to 20 kHz, L/R phase), chorus and delay. Performances combine the layers in single, dual or split mode. Shared performance controls (bender, LFO 2 with six waves, portamento, octave) apply to upper, lower or both; a ribbon controller and polyphonic aftertouch add expression. Separate mix, upper and lower stereo outputs.

modules.name: Keyboard, layers and voice allocation
modules.description: 61 keys with velocity and polyphonic aftertouch; SINGLE, DUAL or SPLIT (split point default C4); per-layer voice assign; hold per layer; two MIDI channels.

modules.name: Bender
modules.description: Left/right bends pitch (to an octave) and LPF cutoff per layer; pushing up (pressure pad) triggers LFO 2.

modules.name: Ribbon controller
modules.description: Pitch bend of held notes by default (direction set by the starting position); becomes a matrix source when assigned (then no pitch control). CC 2/34.

modules.name: LFO 2
modules.description: Sine, reverse saw, S&H, square, saw, sample & glide; RATE, DELAY; triggered by bender push, aftertouch, or always on; to DDS pitch, VCF and VCA per layer; polyphonic as a matrix destination.

modules.name: Pedals
modules.description: Volume pedal, expression pedal (matrix source), dual sustain and dual delay-freeze footswitches.

modules.name: UPPER DDS 1
modules.description: Super-wave core: centroid plus six sister oscillators; sine, saw, square, triangle, noise or alternative waves A/B; PW/WAVE morphs to the next wave; 64'-2'.

modules.name: UPPER DDS 2
modules.description: Algorithmic oscillator: sine, saw, square, triangle, noise, pulse; 32'-2' or LFO (0.1-100 Hz); NORM, RING (with DDS 1) or SYNC; tune ±7 st.

modules.name: UPPER sub oscillator
modules.description: Square or sine one octave below DDS 1, replacing DDS 2's audio when DDS 2 is at LFO range.

modules.name: UPPER mixer
modules.description: MIX balances DDS 1 against DDS 2 (or ring mod, or the sub); SHIFT: layer pan.

modules.name: UPPER high-pass filter
modules.description: 1-pole 6 dB/oct analogue high-pass before the low-pass.

modules.name: UPPER low-pass filter
modules.description: SSI 4-pole 24 dB/oct resonant low-pass, self-oscillating; drive off/1/2; key tracking off, half or full.

modules.name: UPPER VCA
modules.description: ENV 2 or one of two fixed envelopes; LFO 1 and DDS 2 amplitude modulation; velocity dynamics.

modules.name: UPPER ENV 1
modules.description: Attack hold, attack, decay hold, decay, sustain, release (1 ms-10 s); normal, inverted or loop; decay/release key tracking.

modules.name: UPPER ENV 2
modules.description: Attack, decay hold, decay, sustain, release (1 ms-10 s).

modules.name: UPPER LFO 1
modules.description: One per super voice: triangle, reverse saw, S&H, square, HF (20 Hz-20 kHz) or HF TRK; free/once/reset, or HF summed into either DDS; delay; LR phase or pan spread.

modules.name: UPPER chorus
modules.description: Chorus I, II or I + II.

modules.name: UPPER delay
modules.description: 1 ms-1 s (or synced), feedback to infinite, send level; freeze by footswitch.

modules.name: UPPER arpeggiator / sequencer
modules.description: Up, down, up & down, random over 1-4 octaves, or 64-step sequencer (step, slide, accent, rest, length); 16 sequences.

modules.name: LOWER DDS 1
modules.description: Super-wave core: centroid plus six sister oscillators; sine, saw, square, triangle, noise or alternative waves A/B; PW/WAVE morphs to the next wave; 64'-2'.

mod_matrix.note: Each layer has its own matrix (LAYER UPPER/LOWER selects); parameters shown point at the upper layer, the lower layer mirrors them. LFO 1 can also be a direct-mapping source. Assigning the ribbon in the matrix removes its default pitch control. Clear all, by source or by destination with MOD AMOUNT push or SHIFT + MOD ASSIGN.

behaviours.name: Layers and performances
behaviours.rule: A performance holds an upper and a lower layer, each with its own patch, in SINGLE (one layer, 20 voices), DUAL (stacked, 10 each) or SPLIT (10 each around a split point, default C4). Binaural halves each layer's voice count. Storing a performance snapshots both layers; save a layer as a patch to reuse it.

behaviours.name: Per-layer engine
behaviours.rule: Each layer: DDS 1 and DDS 2 (or sub, or ring mod) into MIX, 6 dB HPF, SSI 24 dB LPF with drive, VCA; ENV 1, ENV 2, LFO 1; then chorus and delay (send). Panel rows: upper layer on top, lower layer second.

behaviours.name: Performance controls per layer
behaviours.rule: The bender, LFO 2, portamento and octave settings can differ per layer: set the layer selector to UPPER or LOWER and adjust, or BOTH to copy the upper settings to both. For example, bend the upper layer an octave and the lower a fifth.

behaviours.name: Ribbon controller
behaviours.rule: Pitch bend of held notes (start low and slide up for maximum upward bend, or vice versa); no effect in release. Assigning it in the matrix makes it a modulation source instead.

behaviours.name: DDS 2 modes and sub
behaviours.rule: NORM; RING (DDS 1 x DDS 2 through the DDS 2 channel; cross mod adds carrier modulation); SYNC (DDS 2 slaved, cross mod reversed). At LFO range DDS 2 is a 0.1-100 Hz modulator and the switch selects no sub, a square sub or a sine sub an octave below DDS 1.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer per layer
behaviours.rule: Each layer has its own arpeggiator (up, down, up & down, random; 1-4 octaves; swing) or 64-step sequencer (step, slide, accent, rest, length) and HOLD; tempo 30-300 BPM is shared. 16 sequences stored separately from patches.

behaviours.name: MIDI
behaviours.rule: Upper layer on the base channel, lower on the next; same CC numbers per layer; NRPN = 1024 + CC for 14-bit control. DIN and USB MIDI cannot be used together. MPE reserved.

source_inconsistencies: The oscillator overview says DDS 1 offers 'up to 64' alternative waveforms; the wave chapter describes two groups of 16 (32 in all).
DDS 2's RANGE text says it adjusts 'the coarse frequency of DDS 1'.
Patch group B access is described as accessing 'the performances of group B'.
The patch drive lists 'performances_a' and 'performances_b' as 'groups of 128 performances', but there are 64 per group (2 x 8 x 8 = 128 total).
The ring modulation example says DDS 1 is a square 'at 8 times the frequency of DDS 1'.
The CC table's printed layout drops CC numbers on multi-line rows; numbers were reconstructed from the consecutive order and confirmed at every legible row.

modelling_gaps.detail: Each layer's engine and controls are modelled explicitly (up_ and lo_ prefixes); the matrix lists upper-layer parameters and is mirrored for the lower layer.
Voice modules per_voice; effects, arp/seq, LFO 2 and controllers common or per layer.
Engine detail matches the Super 6 model, with the Super Gemini's additions (wave morph, ring mode, sine sub, VCA DDS 2, delay send, LFO 2 waves, ribbon).
